labs.title: The Everyday Math Detective Agency
labs.mission: Find the mathematics hiding in everyday decisions. Build an estimate, test a strategy, and explain why another person could reason differently.

labs.title: Neighborhood Makers Market
labs.mission: Plan a tiny market stall. Make sensible money decisions and persuade another designer using a clear model and calculation.

labs.title: Pattern Studio Collective
labs.mission: Build a growing pattern that a partner can continue. Share the rule, compare strategies, and revise the design together.

labs.title: The Data Newsroom
labs.mission: Investigate a question whose answers vary. Turn the data into an honest histogram and choose a headline the evidence supports.

labs.title: The Middle Ground Observatory
labs.mission: Help an observatory describe a week of observations. Find the middle and show the spread with a five-number summary.

labs.title: The Consistency Cup
labs.mission: Compare how spread out a team’s results are. Decide whether the range or the middle half tells the more useful story.

labs.title: Delivery Dispatch
labs.mission: Split supplies into equal shipments. Use division, place value, and multiplication checks to prevent a delivery mistake.

labs.title: Fair Share Festival
labs.mission: Redistribute a festival’s supplies fairly, then measure how far the original amounts were from that fair share.

labs.title: The Outlier Investigation
labs.mission: A dramatic number has changed a report. Investigate which measures still describe a typical observation honestly.

labs.title: Decimal Design Shop
labs.mission: Cost out custom designs, track spending, and catch a misplaced decimal before an order goes to production.

labs.title: Recipe Remix Radio
labs.mission: Mix a signature drink and price it fairly. Keep the order of ratio quantities clear and give every unit rate its units.

labs.title: Ratio Railway
labs.mission: Connect a table, a graph, and a constant ratio. Send trains only along a route that preserves the relationship.

labs.title: Mixture Matchup
labs.mission: Compare two paint recipes fairly. Decide which mixture has more color for the same amount of white paint.

labs.title: World Expedition Outfitters
labs.mission: Translate measurements for an expedition. Keep conversion factors visible and distinguish exact conversions from approximate ones.

labs.title: Best Buy Boulevard
labs.mission: Choose supplies for a neighborhood event. Find unit prices, compare deals, and explain when a cheaper unit price is not the whole decision.

labs.title: Scale and Sail Workshop
labs.mission: Prepare matching model boats and full-size plans. Scale ratios consistently and convert lengths without changing the design.

labs.title: Hundred-Square Studio
labs.mission: Create a pixel design and describe the same shaded amount as a fraction, decimal, and percent.

labs.title: Sale Signals Studio
labs.mission: Estimate a discount before finding its exact value. Decide whether the saving and final price on a sale sign make sense.

labs.title: The Missing Whole Bureau
labs.mission: Recover a missing total from a known part and percent. Use the meaning of one percent to test your answer.

labs.title: Shape-Shift Garden
labs.mission: Rearrange garden shapes to understand area. Track perpendicular height while you compare a parallelogram and a triangle.

labs.title: Festival Floorplan
labs.mission: Plan a festival space made from trapezoids and smaller shapes. Decompose the floor plan so that no space is counted twice.

labs.title: Packaging Workshop
labs.mission: Design a rectangular package, count its cubic capacity, and connect its three-dimensional form to a two-dimensional net.

labs.title: Wrap Lab
labs.mission: Compare the covering needed for a prism and a square pyramid. Count every face once and distinguish slant height from vertical height.

labs.title: Polygon Pavilion
labs.mission: Plan a polygon floor and a storage box for a pavilion. Separate square-unit floor coverage from cubic-unit storage capacity.

labs.title: Fraction Food Truck
labs.mission: Measure servings from a supply of ingredients. Use fraction strips to see how many groups fit before using a division procedure.

labs.title: The Power Plant
labs.mission: Power a machine with numerical expressions. Distinguish repeated multiplication from multiplication by an exponent.

labs.title: Expression Remix Studio
labs.mission: Translate a situation into an expression, substitute values, and test whether two expressions stay equivalent.

labs.title: Factor Factory
labs.mission: Arrange products into equal rows. Use common factors to rewrite expressions and connect arrays to the distributive property.

labs.title: Ribbon Rescue
labs.mission: Cut ribbons into fractional lengths. Decide how many pieces fit and distinguish a fractional quotient from the number of complete pieces.

labs.title: Fraction Field Team
labs.mission: Supply a field expedition with fractional quantities. Interpret the quotient in context and check whether the requested groups are possible.

labs.title: Synchronization Station
labs.mission: Synchronize repeating signals. Break numbers into prime factors and predict when two cycles next meet.

labs.title: Algebra Workshop
labs.mission: Unpack grouped expressions and combine matching terms. Build a visual proof that the simplified form preserves the value.

labs.title: Elevation Expedition
labs.mission: Navigate above and below sea level. Represent signed measurements and use zero as a shared reference point.

labs.title: Deep Sea Dispatch
labs.mission: Order underwater locations and measure distance from sea level. Keep absolute value separate from greater-than comparisons.

labs.title: Coordinate Couriers
labs.mission: Deliver parcels on a four-quadrant city grid. Use ordered pairs and calculate distances along horizontal or vertical streets.

labs.title: Grid Architects
labs.mission: Place a park in all four quadrants. Use coordinates to prove its side lengths, perimeter, and area.

labs.title: Mirror Mission
labs.mission: Send a point through coordinate mirrors. Predict which coordinate changes and prove that reflected points stay equally far from the mirror.

labs.title: The Balance Bureau
labs.mission: Test possible solutions and restore balance with inverse operations. Explain why the same operation belongs on both sides.

labs.title: Vault Division
labs.mission: Open evidence vaults by solving multiplication and division equations. A correct key must make the original equation true.

labs.title: Entry Rules Arcade
labs.mission: Write fair entry rules for an arcade. Use inequality symbols and decide whether a boundary value is allowed.

labs.title: Budget Boundaries
labs.mission: Plan a purchase with a limit. Solve an inequality, graph its solutions, and select a sensible whole-number decision.

labs.title: Variable Weather Station
labs.mission: Connect changing quantities through a table and graph. Explain what each variable means and how one responds to the other.

labs.title: Function Food Fair
labs.mission: Compare fair-booth plans with starting fees and per-item costs. Write equations and use them to make a decision.

labs.title: Symmetry Safari
labs.mission: Look for mathematical structure in nature and design. Test symmetry with evidence and connect observations to a precise representation.

labs.title: Invention Playground
labs.mission: Use playful constraints to invent a solution. Build, test, compare strategies, and improve a design with mathematical evidence.

labs.title: My Math, Next
labs.mission: Explore a pattern beyond the first few cases and tell the story of your mathematical growth. Make a claim, test it, and name your next question.
